sample_design: Class balanced proxy sensitivity experiment, not a probability sample for European population estimation.

score_definitions.hard_match_score: M_i, the binary match between the bridged LUCAS class and raw WorldCover class.
score_definitions.proxy_supported_match_score: r_i M_i, which credits a hard match only in proportion to the released geometry proxy and does not identify actual reference support.
score_definitions.residual_compatible_score: r_i M_i+(1-r_i), a deliberately extreme counterfactual convention that credits every unresolved residual area as compatible.
score_definitions.scenario_span: 1-r_i, the algebraic difference between the two conditional score conventions and not an accuracy interval.

interpretation: These are deterministic finite sample score summaries conditional on a released geometry proxy. They do not validate actual reference support and are not lower or upper bounds on latent pixel agreement, confidence intervals, product reliability estimates, or probability sampled European accuracy estimates.
